results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: Management gives no guidance and declined to give an exit MRR. Q2 revenue was ₹224 Cr, close to the roughly ₹75 Cr a month the analysts quoted, so a flat quarter is about ₹225 Cr.
The second B200 lot is due live 'this quarter' (it already slipped from Q2). If it goes live in December it adds only a few weeks of revenue to Q3, so we add about ₹20 Cr to the base.
EBITDA margin has been 75-77% and the MD calls it a '70% plus' business. Depreciation and interest rise as the new GPUs arrive, so PAT grows more slowly than revenue.
risks: Internal use of GPUs for the company's own platform takes capacity away from sale
caveat: Screener's quarterly table for E2E has no Q3 FY26 column, so the year-on-year change cannot be shown.
